evals.prompt: Review supabase/functions/create-quote-from-mac/index.ts for security and convention issues.
evals.expected_output: A findings report, one line per finding in the form <file>:<line> - SEVERITY - problem. fix., covering auth (shared secret verified before any data access), CORS (OPTIONS handled, headers on error paths too, and the shared cors.ts helper's own wildcard-fallback branch traced rather than assumed safe), data access (no SELECT *, untyped Supabase client flagged since a generated Database type exists), validation (validatePayload's hand-rolled shape checking noted alongside its own documented rationale for avoiding zod, and that zod isn't in supabase/functions/deno.json's import map regardless — not a fresh 'switch to zod' recommendation that ignores both), error handling (no swallowed errors, no raw error text leaked to the caller), documentation (missing doc comment on the densest business-logic function), and testability (logic split into _lib.ts, tests don't mock the Supabase client). No rewriting of the function, no praise, no vague findings.
expectations: Findings are reported one per line as <file>:<line> - SEVERITY - problem. fix., not as prose or a rewrite of the function
Checks that the shared secret (or signature) is verified before any data access, on every code path
Traces into the shared cors.ts helper's own wildcard-fallback branch rather than assuming 'uses an allowlist' is automatically safe
Flags the untyped Supabase client (createClient(url, key) instead of createClient<Database>(url, key)) given a generated types file exists

Notes validatePayload's hand-rolled validation together with its documented rationale and zod's absence from deno.json's import map, rather than issuing a blanket 'switch to zod' recommendation that ignores both
Flags any swallowed error or any raw/internal error detail leaked to the caller
Flags the densest business-logic function in _lib.ts for missing a doc comment
Confirms testability findings are about logic living in _lib.ts and tests not mocking the Supabase client
Does not rewrite the function and does not include praise or findings that don't change behavior or risk
